brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress and elevated institutional advisory risk warrant materially reduced exposure. Long signals are weak, composites are near zero, and high-beta alts carry unfavorable alpha, liquidity, and expected-shortfall profiles. ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile because their zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and identical placeholder metrics indicate insufficient or unreliable risk data; treat their long signals as unvalidated.
